input.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as a new General Provisions subsection
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as our playbook requires coverage from any vendor that hosts our platform access and processes our trade data and Confidential Information. We can accept reduced limits of USD 1,000,000 errors and omissions and USD 2,000,000 cyber liability if the stated limits are an issue.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than US$1,000,000 per occurrence and US$2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than US$2,000,000; cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than US$5,000,000 covering Licensor's processing of Licensee data and Confidential Information; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Licensor shall provide certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon Licensee's request.
